finding_history.summary: FDA approved Abilify Maintena (aripiprazole), the first once-monthly dopamine D2 partial-agonist LAI, for treatment of schizophrenia in adults.

source.name: Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. press release

finding_history.summary: FDA approved Abilify Asimtufii (aripiprazole), the first once-every-two-months LAI, for schizophrenia and for maintenance monotherapy treatment of bipolar I disorder in adults — positioned to offset Abilify Maintena's approaching loss of exclusivity.

Abilify Maintena lost market exclusivity (patent expiry) in both the US and Europe in October 2024; GlobalData projected a ~12% sales decline from 2024-2025 and continued erosion through 2029 as generics enter.

Otsuka Pharmaceutical Canada and Lundbeck Canada secured broadened public-plan reimbursement for Abilify Asimtufii, now covering over 90% of Canadians with public drug-plan coverage and ~60% with private coverage, across Ontario, Quebec, BC, Nova Scotia, PEI, Alberta and federal plans including NIHB.

Otsuka Holdings FY2026 H1 (Jan-Jun 2026) results: Abilify Maintena/Asimtufii combined sales rose 19.2% YoY to ¥149.5 billion, driven by expanded North America prescriptions; company also noted generic entry for Abilify Maintena in Europe was slower than initially assumed, supporting stronger-than-expected results.

source.name: BigGo Finance (Otsuka Holdings FY2026 Q2 earnings summary)
